queries.query:
A review package has a generic SKILL.md, but its trigger queries file names a specific company and a fixed list of its repositories. What does the rubric say to do?
A) Accept it, because SKILL.md itself is generic
B) Reject it, because every package asset must be neutral
C) Accept it if the company name is spelled correctly
D) Reject only the SKILL.md and keep the trigger queries

According to the rubric front matter, what is the minimum pass rate for the matrix?
A) 0.5
B) 0.75
C) 0.9
D) 1

queries.evidence: ends the review: there is no top-N cap, no early stop, and all supported findings across every
queries.query:
A reviewer finds one bug and wants to stop and send a short report with only the top three findings. What does the rubric require?
A) Keep going and put all supported findings in one consolidated report
B) Stop at the first bug and send it as a progress finding
C) Send the top three now and the rest later as addenda
D) Stop once the finding count reaches ten

A) The live review found every issue
B) The live review completed its coverage ledger
C) Only that the written protocol is correct; live outputs need separate manual coverage grading
D) Nothing needs further grading
